create_LogicalExpr: create a LogicalExpr with AND/OR/NAND/NOR type and a list of sub-expressions and PDDL entities
test_is_true_from_predicates: test LogicalExpr.is_true_from_predicates to check if the expression evaluates true given a list of predicates
test_is_true: test LogicalExpr.is_true to evaluate the expression against a PddlSimInfo simulation state
review_sub_in: review LogicalExpr.sub_in to substitute PDDL entities in sub-expressions using a mapping dictionary
test_clone: test LogicalExpr.clone to create a deep copy of the logical expression with cloned sub-expressions
